methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This article therefore investigates the different project types that can be identified using existing data sources. The parameters required for project identification are specified

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents an automated energy-efficiency project-identification system that derives project-potential parameters and savings estimates from SCADA data collected by an ISO 50001 EnMS. ISO 50001/EnMS appears only as data-source and reporting context; no EnPI or energy-baseline (EnB) measurement model is presented or characterised. The methodology is a set of project-detection thresholds plus a compressor adiabatic-power savings equation, which are not EnPI/EnB models (tool/software without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content).

paper_type.evidence_quote: further update the project identification software with the latest projects
